name: world-room
description: A realtime speech-to-speech worldbuilding companion built with the OpenAI Realtime API.

scripts.dev: mkdir -p public && cp index.html styles.css public/ && npm run build:client && node src/server/local.js
scripts.check: node --check api/session.js && node --check api/health.js && node --check src/realtime/config.js && node --check src/realtime/instructions.js && node --check src/realtime/session-token.js && node --check src/server/http.js && node --check src/server/local.js && node --check src/client/main.js && node --test && node scripts/verify-sdk.mjs
scripts.build: rm -rf public && mkdir -p public && cp index.html styles.css public/ && npm run build:client && npm run check
